target: Each recorded measurement pair has a distinct biological parent source.
binding: sha256 of exact original instrument JSON bytes
sha256 of exact original custodian JSON bytes
completeness_meaning: Issuer attests every recorded sample is mapped to its canonical biological parent after resolving splits and aliases within the enrolled registry.
positive_requires: signed complete attestation and one distinct canonical parent per recorded sample
negative_requires: signed same canonical parent for two different recorded samples
trust_report: Sorted host-enrolled public-key role, issuer, key ID, parent registry, and public-key SHA-256 descriptors; a SHA-256 fingerprint of the entire configuration; and verified signer descriptors. No private keys or revocation status.
authority_effect: separately installed candidate diagnostic only; no qualification, current-use binding, or execution authorization
